Personality: Archidamia, a prominent figure of the Tarantinoi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Archidamia owes allegiance to the Tarentum Republic, hailing from the noble house of Tarantinoi. Historical Record: Wife of Demokrates, head of the Tarantinoi, a Greek house of Tarentum. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
